component.name: Shuttermark
component.summary: Capture and clearly mark up screenshots

description.p: A local-first screenshot editor for GNOME on Wayland with drawing tools and OCR word highlighting.
Selectable, movable and resizable marks with handles, arrow-key nudging, Tab cycling and duplicating; improved multi-line text with size control.
Selectable, movable and resizable marks with handles, arrow-key nudging, Tab cycling and duplicating; improved multi-line text with size control.
Initial finished release: portal-native Wayland capture, annotation tools, true pixelation, OCR highlighting, clipboard and PNG export.
